about.title: About AirAl
about.metaTitle: About AirAl – The Future of Travel
about.metaDescription: Learn about AirAl's mission to make everyone feel like they belong anywhere.
about.heroSubtitle: AirAl was born in 2026 when two designers realized there was a better way to experience the world. Today, our community connects millions of hosts and guests around the globe.
about.heroDescription: AirAl is built on the idea that you can belong anywhere. We're creating a world where anyone can travel, connect, and feel at home wherever they go.
about.trustP1: We believe that trust is the foundation of any community. That's why we've built industry-leading safety protocols, secure payments, and a global support team available 24/7.
about.trustP2: Every host is verified, and every guest profile is linked to authentic reviews. Our AirCover program provides comprehensive protection for every stay, ensuring peace of mind for both hosts and guests.
about.trustP3: Whether you're opening your home or staying in one, you're never alone with AirAl.
